canonical_statement: Produce a positive integer a with 1<=a<10^20 and an integer x0 with 1455091<=x0<=10000000 such that x^12+a is composite for every positive integer 1<=x<x0, while x0^12+a is prime. The threshold is one above the strongest same-form public example found in the 2026-08-14 search (a=26060579, reported x0=1455090). That report is a provisional experimental baseline, not an independently certified current world record. Acceptance establishes the exact finite instance only, not global optimality or novelty.
success_criterion: The content-pinned amf.aim60.certificate.v2 checker accepts after enumerating every positive predecessor, validating every congruence rule and remaining exact factor, and checking an Atkin--Morain ECPP proof for x0^12+a. A refreshed record search and independent certification of the provisional baseline remain mandatory before any novelty claim.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain an independent certificate reconstruction for the reported x0=1455090 instance, exact candidates between the old 616980 example and the v2 threshold, stronger congruence covers, and reusable certificate-generation improvements.
stop_conditions: A current source reports an in-domain first-prime index at least as large as the v2 threshold.
The provisional 1455090 baseline or the positive-a interpretation fails independent reconstruction.
The verifier reaches its deterministic resource limits or the separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
